divisions.title: Judgment on Israel and Judah
divisions.summary: Samaria and Jerusalem face divine judgment for idolatry, injustice, and corrupt leadership.

divisions.title: Future Hope and the Ruler from Bethlehem
divisions.summary: Zion exalted among nations, a ruler born in Bethlehem who will shepherd Israel in peace.

divisions.title: God's Case and Final Hope
divisions.summary: God brings his lawsuit against Israel, demands justice and mercy, then promises forgiveness and restoration.
